pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Clueless
work.note: Clueless é uma comédia americana escrita e dirigida por Amy Heckerling, lançada em 1995. A protagonista é Cher, uma adolescente rica de Beverly Hills, sociável e segura de si, que gosta de ajudar os outros, embora nem sempre entenda o que acontece. A obra conversa com o foco da aula: “preparar um presente: wrap a present (embrulhar) e a gift for + pessoa (um presente para)”. A referência mostra festas e presentes: wr

pages.title: A short break · 1/3
paragraphs: It is ten thirty in a busy office in Chicago. Rui looks at his screen for a long time. His eyes are tired and he needs a break. He walks to the breakroom at the end of the hall. A coworker named Kim stands by the coffee machine. She smiles and holds up a cup.
“Hi, Rui! Do you want some coffee?” says Kim. “Yes, please. Is it fresh?” says Rui. “I made it ten minutes ago.” says Kim.

paragraphs: “Great. Do you have a meeting after lunch?” says Rui. “Yes, at two. See you at noon!” says Kim. Rui takes a cup of coffee and says thank you. They talk about work for five minutes.
